member.name: T:FCMCore.Auth.FcmAccessTokenProvider
member.summary: Obtains and caches the OAuth2 access token used to authenticate FCM requests.

remarks.para: FCM requires a two-step exchange: this provider signs a short-lived JWT assertion (RS256) with the service account's private key, then POSTs it to Google's OAuth2 token endpoint to receive an access token. That access token (valid for about an hour) is what authorizes each messages:send call.
The token is fetched lazily and reused until shortly before it expires. The instance is thread-safe and makes at most one concurrent token request.
